title: myroxylon schaefferioides
intro: Myroxylon schaefferioides, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and stress, and promote better sleep. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against infections and oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include sesquiterpenes, particularly beta-selinene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
